title: Senior Payroll Analyst
description:
GAQ327R247

As part of the Databricks Payroll team, you will join a dynamic global organisation that is helping our customers solve some of their toughest problems. You will also ensure our employees are paid accurately, on time, and in compliance with all requirements-allowing them to focus on doing their best work. This role is ideal for a payroll professional who loves hands-on processing, thrives on problem-solving, and brings strong systems skills to handle complex payroll cases without escalation.

The Senior Payroll Analyst  will work closely with the Payroll Director to support accurate and timely payroll processing for our Asia region-specifically Australia, Korea, Japan & Singapore, this may change as per org need and design. You will collaborate with payroll vendors, internal partners, and employees to deliver compliant, efficient payroll operations. While you will not be solely responsible for payroll execution, you will play a key role in preparing, validating, and reconciling payroll data, responding to employee inquiries, and supporting projects and process improvements. 

This role reports to the Payroll Director based in UK.

The impact you will have: 

• Payroll processing support - Partner with the Payroll Analyst team in India to prepare, validate, and reconcile payroll data for the countries specified above or as per org design, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery.

• Data validation & audits - Perform pre- and post-processing checks to identify and resolve discrepancies before payroll is finalized.

• Vendor collaboration - Work closely with payroll vendors to troubleshoot issues, resolve variances, and meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• Compliance adherence - Ensure payroll operations follow internal controls, statutory regulations, and company policies for each country.

• Employee case resolution - Respond to and resolve payroll inquiries through the case management tool, providing accurate and timely support.

• Process improvement - Identify and recommend scalable solutions to enhance payroll efficiency and accuracy.

• Documentation maintenance - Develop and update payroll process documentation to support consistency and knowledge sharing.

• Project participation - Contribute to payroll-related projects, system enhancements, and testing activities in the ASIA region.

What we look for:

• Regional payroll expertise - 5-7 years of payroll processing experience in Asia region.

• Global Team Environment - experience working for a multinational and high-growth company.

• Regulatory knowledge - Solid understanding of statutory payroll requirements, including taxes, social security, and government reporting for each supported country.

• System proficiency - Experience with Workday Payroll or a similar HRIS/payroll system, with the ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly.

• Analytical & technical skills - Intermediate Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs, formulas) and the ability to analyze and reconcile payroll data for accuracy.

• Case management experience - Familiarity with case management tools, SLAs, and metrics to track and improve service delivery.

• Language skills - Fluency in English and Spanish; Portuguese is a strong plus.

• Collaboration & communication - Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners in HR, Finance, and external vendors.

Why You’ll Love This Role:

This position is perfect for someone who:

• Thrives in a collaborative environment, working closely with other payroll colleagues while contributing to accurate and timely payrolls across multiple countries.

• Enjoys solving payroll challenges and ensuring compliance with local regulations.

• Wants exposure to multi-country payroll complexities and the opportunity to strengthen Asia payroll expertise.

• Values process improvement and the chance to contribute ideas that make payroll operations more efficient.

title: Compliance Operations Analyst
description:
About RemotePass
RemotePass exists because talent is distributed equally, but opportunity is not. Backed by EBRD and trusted by 800+ companies across 150+ countries, RemotePass is the platform that gives businesses the infrastructure to hire anyone, anywhere - and gives workers in emerging markets the financial tools and global access they deserve.
RemotePass is the only platform that combines Employer of Record, contractor management, direct employment, and corporate spend cards in a single product - rated 4.8/5 on G2, trusted by Spotify, Logitech, and Deloitte, and operating across 150+ countries. We are backed by leading global investors, including Oraseya Capital, Endeavor Catalyst, Khwarizmi Ventures, Flyer One Ventures, Access Bridge Ventures, A15, Swiss Founders Fund, and Plug & Play.
The role
RemotePass verifies, screens, and monitors clients and contractors through risk-based onboarding and compliance workflows before payment activity is enabled. We're growing our Compliance Operations team and looking for an Analyst to help handle the day-to-day: reviewing company documents, verifying contractor identities, running sanctions checks, and flagging anything that doesn't look right.
You'll work closely with two other analysts and report into our Head of Operations, with our Head of Compliance as your escalation point for anything that needs a second set of eyes. You don't need to be a compliance expert on day one - you need real hands-on exposure to KYC/KYB and a sharp eye for detail, and we'll help you build the rest.
What you'll do

• Review client KYB documentation - corporate registration, ownership structure, proof of operations, authorized representatives

• Support contractor KYC - verifying IDs, resolving address or payment detail mismatches, handling jurisdictional flags

• Run sanctions, PEP, and adverse media checks using our approved tools and procedures

• Investigate payment issues - failed payouts, payment detail changes, cross-border payment concerns

• Keep our compliance trackers, evidence folders, and case notes accurate and audit-ready

• Escalate potential fraud, sanctions risk, unusual activity, or policy violations quickly and clearly.

• Work cross-functionally with Customer Success and Operations on client-facing requests

Requirements

• 1-3 years of hands-on compliance experience - KYC, KYB, client/customer onboarding, or sanctions screening, ideally at a payment processor, bank, crypto exchange, or money transmitter

• Comfortable reviewing documents carefully and spotting what's missing, inconsistent, or unclear

• Good written English - you can write a clean case note and a clear client request

• Comfortable with spreadsheets, case queues, and juggling multiple open cases at once

• High attention to detail, with the judgment to know when something needs to be escalated rather than closed

• Arabic fluency is a strong plus, not a requirement

Benefits

• Remote-First Culture: We don't just sell remote work; we live it. Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere.

• Hyper-Growth: Be part of a company that is consistently recognized for its rapid expansion and innovation.

• Inclusion Matters: We are committed to building a diverse team. We value different perspectives and empower every individual to bring their authentic self to work.

As we expand our focus on organic search and AI visibility across key markets, we are looking for an SEO Site Manager to support our growth, with a particular focus on Brazil and Mexico.

You’ll take ownership of SEO performance across your assigned markets, working closely with content, product, marketing, and other cross-functional teams to turn strategy into action and deliver measurable organic growth and business impact.

title: Research Intern, Frontier Agents (Summer 2027)
description:
About the Role

The Agents team investigates how to build, align, and scale frontier AI systems that can tackle complex, multi-step tasks and workflows across text and speech, with a particular focus on agentic and scientific domains. Our work sits at the intersection of agent capabilities, human-computer interaction, and infrastructure-from designing post-training methods for agentic behavior to developing evaluation frameworks for open-ended tasks where traditional metrics fall short. 

As a research intern, you will work on problems at the frontier of agentic AI, where challenges in alignment, reliability, and scalability are deeply intertwined. Projects may involve developing new training recipes for self-learning and long-horizon reasoning, curating datasets for non-deterministic scientific and agentic tasks, studying failure modes in agentic behavior, or building infrastructure that enables agent operations at scale. You'll operate in a space where algorithmic innovation, dataset and interaction design, and systems work come together to push the boundaries of what AI agents can reliably accomplish.

Responsibilities

• Research and implement novel techniques in one or more of our focus areas

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments to validate hypotheses

• Document findings in scientific publications and blog posts

• Communicate the plans, progress, and results of projects to the broader team

Requirements

• Currently pursuing a Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Science, or a related field

• Publications at leading ML, NLP, or speech conferences or journals (such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, *ACL, EMNLP, Interspeech)

• Strong knowledge of Machine Learning and Deep Learning fundamentals

• Experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.)

• Understanding of how LLMs work

• Strong programming skills in Python

• Familiarity with Transformer architectures and recent developments in foundation models

Example Research Directions

• Training, developing, and evaluating frontier models, especially in the domain of agentic tasks and workflows

• Designing and curating datasets for frontier agents alignment and post-training

• Studying failure modes and developing safety paradigms for agentic behavior

• Research new recipes (for RL or test time scaling) for self-learning and long-context tasks completion

• Building agents that act on spoken input to carry out complex, multi-step tasks

• Developing ML infrastructure that can power agent operations at scale

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Internship Program Details

Our internship program runs 12 to 14 weeks, giving you the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading engineers and researchers across multiple teams. This cohort's internship dates span either May 17th to August 6th or June 14th to September 3rd. 

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, housing stipends, and other competitive benefits. The estimated US hourly rate for this role is $58 - $70 an hour. Our hourly rates are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

title: Fòs Feminista Board of Directors and Standing Committee Members
description:
Position Summary
Fòs Feminista is inviting applications for new members of its Board of Directors and standing committees. For the 2026 elections, we seek candidates whose experience and perspectives will complement the current Board and committees, in particular with financial and investment expertise and audit, risk, and governance experience. We encourage applications from feminist leaders under 25 at the time of election who have a record of leadership in youth-led movements, digital participation, or community organizing, especially in the Global South.
Opportunities in 2026
Board Directors
Fòs Feminista is governed by an 11-member Board of Directors. Board Directors guide strategy and share responsibility for the Alliance's governance and financial health. Board Directors attend three meetings each year, and each Director serves on at least one standing committee. All Board Directors carry the legal duties of care, loyalty, and obedience to mission; disclose potential conflicts of interest annually; and uphold Fòs Feminista ’s safeguarding policy.
The term is for three years, renewable for up to two additional consecutive terms. Board service is unpaid. Fòs Feminista arranges, covers, or reimburses eligible travel expenses for organizational and governance work.
Standing Committee Members
The Board's work is supported by six standing committees: Advocacy; Audit and Risk Intelligence; Finance and Investment; Governance; Partnerships and Performance; and Resource Mobilization.
What We Are Seeking in 2026
To complement the experience already represented on the Board and its committees, we are prioritizing candidates with one or more of the following:

• Youth leadership. Rights-based leaders under 25 at the time of election, with substantive experience in youth-led movements, digital advocacy, and community or health organizing, particularly in the Global South.

• Finance and investment. Experience in financial leadership, gender-lens investing, innovative financing, or women's economic empowerment.

• Strategic communications and external relations.

• Movement and civil society leadership. Deep roots in civil society networks, feminist organizations, or social movements, particularly in Latin America and the Caribbean and across the Global South.

• Governance. Board or senior leadership experience, particularly in Global South organizations.

What All Candidates Should Bring

• Commitment to SRHRJ, and the ability to communicate about this work.

• Understanding of the changing political, economic, and global public health landscape.

• A horizontal approach to leadership, including a willingness to share and build collective power, interrogate established practices, and enable innovation.

• Integrity, equanimity, active listening, confidence in taking risks, and the ability to build consensus across differences.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work across cultures and institutional contexts.

• The ability to connect Fòs Feminista with new partners, funders, and other social justice movements.

How to Apply: Please submit your Curriculum Vitae and a cover letter (one page) here by October 12, 2026. Please state clearly whether you are applying for the Board, a standing committee, or both. Applications are accepted in English, Spanish, French, and Portuguese.
The Governance Committee will contact shortlisted candidates to arrange interviews in late October and early November.

title: Software Engineer, Location & Motion (Inertial Navigation / GNSS)
description:
About Rivet
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

We’re looking for an experienced engineer to own the navigation and positioning stack for Rivet’s head-worn and body-worn systems. You will be responsible for turning inertial and GNSS sensor data into a robust, continuous estimate of position and orientation across challenging real-world environments. This includes sensor calibration and characterization, inertial navigation, GNSS integration, and the estimation algorithms that bring these inputs together. You will work closely with our perception team to define how navigation and visual tracking complement one another and provide a stable experience to downstream systems. This is a highly hands-on role spanning algorithms, embedded software, hardware integration, laboratory testing, and field validation.

Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end 9-axis inertial sensing system, including accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer calibration, synchronization, coordinate frames, and attitude estimation.

- Develop robust heading and inertial navigation solutions that account for sensor errors, environmental disturbances, temperature variation, and platform effects.

- Own GNSS integration and performance, including receiver configuration, raw measurement analysis, signal quality characterization, and resilience to degraded or unreliable positioning environments.

- Design and maintain the navigation fusion estimator, combining inertial, GNSS, and other available measurements into a continuous position, velocity, and attitude solution with well-characterized uncertainty.

- Develop calibration and characterization methods for production and field use, including sensor characterization, per-unit calibration, and automated validation.

- Partner with hardware, firmware, mechanical, and manufacturing teams on sensor selection, placement, mechanical integration, power and thermal constraints, and production test requirements.

- Define interfaces between the navigation and perception systems, including transitions between absolute navigation and relative visual tracking.

- Build the testing and validation infrastructure needed to measure navigation performance, replay real-world data, diagnose failures, and prevent regressions across releases.

Requirements

- BS + 8 years, MS + 5 years, or PhD + 3 years of experience in navigation, aerospace/GNC, robotics, geomatics, or a closely related field.

- Demonstrated experience owning and shipping a production navigation solution that provides position and attitude estimates.

- Strong hands-on experience with inertial sensing, magnetometer calibration, heading estimation, GNSS, and sensor fusion.

- Deep understanding of strapdow

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor-hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.
Step 5 - Matchmaking Time
Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way-with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Die BlueBranch GmbH in Fürth baut eigene Apps. Kein Agentur-Ping-Pong, keine Website-Pflege: Wir entwickeln Produkte, die im App Store und bei Google Play stehen und jeden Tag von echten Menschen genutzt werden. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, arbeiten täglich mit KI-Tools und bringen eine Idee in Tagen in den Store, nicht in Monaten. Wir suchen kein Design-Rädchen, sondern jemanden, der unsere Apps in Look, Feel und Marke auf das Niveau der besten Apps im Store hebt. Weil das nur mit echtem Ownership funktioniert, bieten wir dir eine Gewinnbeteiligung am Unternehmen.
Aufgaben
- Du designst unsere Apps von der ersten Skizze bis zum fertigen Screen für iOS und Android. Fokus 100 % App, keine Websites.
- Du setzt den Standard: Interfaces, die sich anfühlen wie die besten Apps im Store. Micro-Interactions, Animationen, Haptik, Details, die man spürt.
- Du entwickelst und pflegst Corporate Identity und Corporate Design unserer App-Marken: Logo, Farben, Typografie, Bildsprache, Tonalität. Konsistent vom App-Icon bis zum Store-Listing.
- Du gestaltest Social-Media-Postings, Reels-Formate, Store-Screenshots, App-Preview-Videos und Ad-Creatives, die unsere Apps sichtbar machen.
- Du baust und pflegst unser Design-System mit Tokens, Komponenten, Typografie und Motion und sorgst dafür, dass es im Code genauso ankommt, wie es gemeint war.
- Du designst mit KI: Mit Figma AI, Claude, ChatGPT, v0 oder Midjourney erkundest du Varianten, erstellst Prototypen und Assets. Dann verfeinerst du die beste Richtung mit deinem eigenen Urteil.
- Du verantwortest UX-Entscheidungen auf Grundlage von Daten: Onboarding, Paywalls und Conversion-Strecken gestaltest du und misst ihren Erfolg mit Funnel-Analysen, A/B-Tests und Nutzerfeedback.
- Du bringst Designs zum Leben mit Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, Lottie oder Rive.
- Du achtest auf Barrierefreiheit, Tablet-Layouts, Apple HIG und Material Design.

title: Initiativbewerbung
description:
über uns
Hey! Wir sind nucao, das Leipziger Food-Startup, das beweist, dass Genuss und Gutes tun Hand in Hand gehen. Unsere Mission: Wir krempeln die Schokoladenindustrie um. Mit Snacks, die nicht nur unglaublich lecker, sondern auch bio, vegan, fair gehandelt und revolutionär verpackt sind.

We change the game, for good - BAM!
deine rolle

Du willst immer auf dem neuesten Stand bleiben, was unsere aktuellen Vakanzen angeht? Dann melde dich gerne hier zu unserem Job-Newsletter an!
Du feierst unsere Mission, aber die passende Rolle fehlt?
Cool, dass du proaktiv bist! Wir lieben diesen Drive. Bevor du aber deine Unterlagen hochlädst, hier ein ehrlicher Einblick von uns:
1. Wir besetzen sehr gezielt. Wir sind ein Startup. Das heißt: Wir schaffen neue Stellen meist erst dann, wenn der Bedarf akut ist. Wir haben selten die Kapazität, eine Stelle "um eine Person herum" zu bauen. Die Chance, dass eine Initiativbewerbung zu einem Job führt, ist daher meistens unrealisitisch, selbst wenn dein Profil großartig ist.
2. Schau erst auf unsere Job-Liste. Bitte prüfe unbedingt zuerst unsere offenen Stellen. Passt da wirklich nichts? Auch nicht zu 80%? Eine Bewerbung auf eine konkrete Stelle landet immer schneller beim richtigen Hiring Manager.
3. Du bist trotzdem überzeugt, dass du das fehlende Puzzleteil bist? Du hast Skills, von denen wir noch gar nicht wissen, dass wir sie brauchen? Oder du hast eine konkrete Idee, wie du nucao voranbringst?Dann: Go for it!

dein skillset

Was wir von dir brauchen: Da es keine Stellenbeschreibung gibt, liegt der Ball bei dir.

• Lade deinen CV hoch.

• Wichtig: Verrate uns im Motivationsschreiben (oder Video) nicht nur, wer du bist, sondern welches konkrete Problem du bei uns lösen möchtest . In welchem Bereich siehst du deinen Impact?

Wir sind gespannt auf deinen Pitch!

was wir bieten

Wir fordern viel, aber wir geben verdammt viel zurück.

• Deine Lernkurve? Senkrecht! Wir glauben an dein Potenzial und geben dir früh Verantwortung. Du bist ein vollwertiges Teammitglied und lernst in einem rasant wachsenden Startup.

• Echter Impact, der schmeckt: Bei uns ist Sinnhaftigkeit kein Buzzword. Du forderst aktiv die großen Player heraus, indem du die internen Strukturen und Prozesse schaffst, die wir für unser schnelles Wachstum und den Erfolg unserer Mission brauchen.

• Fokus auf deine Stärken: Wir fördern dich aktiv. Mit Tools wie dem Clifton StrengthsFinder entdecken wir, was dich antreibt, und bauen deine Talente aus.

• Teamzusammenhalt: Auf dich wartet ein hochmotiviertes Team, das dich intensiv einarbeitet und mithilft. Und natürlich legendäre Teamevents - von Baumpflanzaktionen bis zu wilden Partys.

• Echte Benefits: Kostenloses veganes Mittagessen im Office, Remote-Zuschuss, Supplements für deine Gesundheit, Urban Sports Club, soviel nucao wie du essen kannst und eine moderne betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit ETF-Sparplänen.

Praven Intelekt is an innovative AI platform designed to streamline legal research, case law analysis, and document drafting. As part of the Lexroom group, Praven combines high-precision local legal intelligence with a fast-scaling European AI infrastructure.

Together, we are building the next generation of legaltech tools for professionals across Europe.

Lexroom http://Lexroom.ai, is building the AI platform where legal work gets done. In just over two years, we've grown from zero to €25M ARR, and today more than 20,000 legal professionals across Italy, Spain, Germany, France, and Bulgaria rely on Lexroom.
We're backed by $73M from Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners, and Eurazeo, and we're a team of around 300 builders who move fast, say things straight, and own each outcome.
Our next goal? Become Europe's most-used legal product.

 

Our mission is clear: make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable, giving legal experts the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters. We are scaling rapidly across CEE and Western Europe, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team dedicated to rigor, clarity, and real-world impact.

 

WHY JOIN US?

- Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.

- Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values technical competence, curiosity, and ambition.

- Deliver Meaningful Impact: Your work will directly transform how legal professionals operate-bringing unprecedented speed and clarity to their daily workflows.

At Lexroom and Praven, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, and a new standard for the legal world.

description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Direct Tax Lead to own our US income tax provision, compliance, and controls, reporting to the Head of Tax. ElevenLabs operates through its US entity and ~9 international entities and is growing fast, which means the provision, the compliance calendar, and the controls around them need a dedicated owner.

This is a hands-on ownership role. The provision and returns are prepared by external providers; you manage those engagements and are accountable for the output. You'll own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision (deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate rec, footnote disclosures), the US federal and state compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimated payments), and the technical work underneath it: §174 capitalization, §382 and NOL tracking.

You'll also assist in designing, documenting, and operating controls, and write the memos that support our positions, working directly with our Big 4 advisors and external auditors alongside the Head of Tax.

REQUIREMENTS

- Deep ASC 740 expertise at a multinational - provision, deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate reconciliation, and footnote disclosure

- Experience owning a US federal and multistate compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimates)

- Working knowledge of US international provisions (NCTI/GILT

title: Founding Sales @Hodor (backed by Hexa)
description:
Hodor is the security gateway for AI agent governance - between your harnesses and your applications, making sure each agent has the right tools for the right job. Nothing more.

https://www.hodor.ai/

Create your territory. Cold call. Own your pipe end to end. This is the first sales hire at Hodor - no inbound, no SDR feeding you, no playbook to inherit. You decide who to attack, you pick up the phone, you close, and you write the motion the rest of the sales team will run on. Build like a founder.

- Create your own territory - choose the segments, accounts and personas worth attacking, and defend the thesis.

- Cold call, every day. Phone, email, LinkedIn, events - whatever gets the first real conversation.

- Own your pipeline end to end: discovery, technical evaluation, security review, pricing, negotiation, close.

Run POCs with security and platform teams, and turn pilots into signed contracts.

Write the playbook as you go - ICP, qualification, objection handling, pricing, and the collateral behind it.

- Bring the market back to the product: what enterprises ask for, what blocks a deal, what wins one.

- Stand up the GTM stack - CRM discipline, sequences, forecasting - so the next hires inherit a system, not a mess.

- Represent Hodor in the field: meetups, conferences, CISO and platform-leader circles.

- Hire and ramp the first AEs and SDRs once the motion is repeatable.

What you bring

- Real closing experience in B2B SaaS - you've carried a quota and beaten it, and you can walk through the deals.

- You cold call without flinching. Prospection is the job, not a chore you delegate.

- Comfort selling a technical product to technical buyers - CISOs, CTOs, platform and security teams.

- Founder mentality: no inbound, no playbook, no safety net - you'd rather build the machine than operate someone else's.

- Enterprise deal instincts: multiple stakeholders, procurement, security questionnaires, legal.

- Fluent in French and English - we sell in France first, Europe next.

Nice to have

- You've sold cybersecurity, developer tools, or data infrastructure.

- You were among the first ten at a startup and watched a GTM motion go from zero to repeatable.

- Familiarity with AI agents, MCP, or how large enterprises are actually deploying LLMs internally.

- You build your own GTM tooling and automations (Clay, HubSpot, Apollo) rather than just using them.

Not for you if…

- You need inbound leads or an SDR to fill your calendar.

- You want a defined territory, a mature playbook, and a comp plan that never moves.

- You think cold calling is beneath you.

- You'd rather manage a team than close deals yourself for the first year.

- You prefer fully-remote work (we work 3+ days a week from the office).

- You don't thrive at the fast pace of early-stage startups.

Why join us

- A real problem to solve: AI agent security is the strategic question of the moment. It isn't one more feature - it's a defence against an existential risk for large enterprises.

- You're not joining a sales org, you're founding one - and the playbook has your name on it.

- Momentum: pre-seed already raised (Hexa and others), seed planned within 6-12 months. You join a team that's accelerating.

- Winners of the VivaTech Innovation of the Year award, and part of a top Station F programme.

- Work shoulder to shoulder with the founders, with a direct line to the roadmap you're selling.

- French and sovereign by design - based in Paris, French infrastructure, European values.

description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

THE MISSION

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Platform Vision: Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.

- Unified Entitlements: Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.

- Pricing & Packaging Delivery: Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.

- Metering & Usage Visibility: Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.

- Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle: Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.

- Enterprise & Marketplace Motions: Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel motions to the billing stack: CPQ-to-entitlement sync, bespoke contract handling, invoice-based billing, and marketplace billing across AWS, GCP, and Azure as we expand our presence there.

- Fulfillment Automation: Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.

• Integrate and analyze data from VBA, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), other VA organizations, Department of Labor, Department of War, and other relevant interagency sources.

• Analyze information collected through surveys, interviews, focus groups, and other research methods.

• Develop program performance metrics and provide monthly and ad hoc performance reporting, dashboards, and decision-support products.

• Conduct gap analyses, SWOT analyses, data mapping, performance assessments, and other analytical studies.

• Use analytics to identify and prioritize TAP modernization and continuous-improvement opportunities, including initiatives with the greatest potential operational or programmatic return.

• Support development of strategic action plans and modernization implementation plans based on analytical findings.

• Establish measures for pilots and modernization initiatives, evaluate results, and recommend whether and how successful approaches should be scaled.

• Translate complex analyses into actionable findings and recommendations that can be operationalized by TAP leadership.

• Prepare executive-level reports, briefings, presentations, and documentation for Government leadership and interagency stakeholders.

title: Video Editor / Creative Producer - Marketing & Direct Response
description:
About Scaling.com

Scaling.com is a high-end research and advisory firm helping established entrepreneurs scale their businesses 10x and build companies that no longer depend on the founder. We combine original research, books, strategic advising, and a modern media engine to reach leaders who are ready to make consequential changes.
Our books are central to that mission. The Science of Scaling is a primary path into our work, and Power Law Strategy is the next major expression of it. Our creative library includes bestselling books, major podcast appearances, founder interviews, case studies, live events, trainings, and hundreds of verified customer stories.
We are building a creative team with the intellectual depth of a research firm, the taste of a premium editorial studio, and the accountability of a serious performance business. If you want to make work that has substance, measurable impact, and room for original judgment, this could be the defining work of your career.
The Mission
Create performance video that earns the attention and trust of serious entrepreneurs and moves the right people toward Scaling.com . We are building toward at least 40 qualified, attended enrollment calls and 10 or more enrollments per day. Your work helps create the qualified demand behind that goal.
The path is straightforward: a strong idea and credible source material become a persuasive video ad; paid distribution gives us real feedback; that feedback makes the next piece better. The work must be both beautiful and effective. Attention without trust is not enough, and polish without response is not enough.
What This Role Is
This is a hands-on performance-video role. You will receive a developed angle, key lines, source material, brand context, and performance learning. With editorial judgment and room to experiment, you will turn a strong idea into a finished paid-social ad that earns attention, builds trust, and moves the right founder to act. Think like a creative partner: understand the business idea behind the ad, spot when an angle or edit weakens the argument, and propose a better way through. The right piece can bring a founder to ideas that change how they build and lead.
You own the creative translation: approved footage, testimonials, B-roll, voiceover, motion graphics, typography, pacing, sound, color, and captions. Build and edit in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. In Premiere, you’ll build the narrative, design the sound with music and sound effects, and add appropriate visuals. In After Effects, you’ll design and animate typography, callouts, and explanatory visuals. Protect the accuracy and context of source material, research, and customer stories. Deliver organized, editable projects with traceable sources, then create purposeful variations informed by performance.
Our production workflow uses Adobe Premiere Pro for editing and Adobe After Effects for motion graphics. Editors currently using DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro are welcome to apply, but must use Premiere Pro for team editing and project handoffs once they join. Hands-on After Effects proficiency is required. You will work within Kevin Anson’s established process for source review, creative development, feedback, versioning, and delivery. Use AI to improve speed and execution while retaining responsibility for the finished work.
Who You'll Work With

• Raleigh Norton, Head of Brand: Sets company-level creative direction, messaging, and the final standard.

• Cody Wood, Media Buyer: Shares performance feedback, economics, and what is winning at scale.

• Ben Lee Milner and the creative strategy/ad-writing team: Develop angles, hooks, scripts, and proof.

• Kevin Anson, Head of Performance Post-Production: Leads the editors, directs post-production, sets the quality bar, and helps the team improve.

Requirements
Three Requirements

• Proven performance at scale. You have personally produced and edited direct-response paid-social video for high-consideration

title: Insurance Sales Agent, Existing Customers
description:
At Globe Life, we are committed to empowering our employees with the support and opportunities they need to succeed at every stage of their career. We take pride in fostering a caring and innovative culture that enables us to collectively grow and overcome challenges in a connected, collaborative, and mutually respectful environment that calls us to help Make Tomorrow Better.
Role Overview:
Could you be our next Insurance Sales Agent, Existing Customers ? Globe Life is looking for an Insurance Sales Agent, Existing Customers to join the team!
In this role, you will engage existing customers through phone calls, applying consultative sales techniques to match them with coverage solutions tailored to their individual needs.
A Life, Accident, and Health Insurance license is required for this role; however, if you do not yet hold one, Globe Life invests in your success by covering the cost of obtaining your license.
This is a remote/work-from-home position.
What You Will Do:

• Drive sales by engaging with existing customers through outbound and inbound calls to identify and present additional coverage options tailored to their needs.

• Clearly communicate policy benefits and confidently guide customers toward informed coverage decisions with professionalism and care.

• Accurately process policy documentation, correspondence, and service corrections to ensure a seamless customer experience.

What You Can Bring:

• High School diploma or equivalent required; some college preferred.

• A Life, Accident, and Health Insurance license is required for this position. If you are not yet licensed, we will pay for you to obtain the necessary licensing.

• At least one year of customer service, phone-based sales, or related customer-facing experience.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to build rapport and trust with customers over the phone.

• Strong time-management, organizational, and decision-making skills.

• Ability to work under pressure with professionalism, tact, and confidentiality.

• Comfortable working with numbers, data entry, and computer-based systems.

• Ability to navigate multiple systems simultaneously while maintaining a high level of customer engagement.

• Knowledge of Life and Health insurance operations is a plus.

Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:

• Reliable and predictable attendance of your assigned shift.

• Ability to work full time and/or part time based on the position specifications.

How Globe Life Will Support You:
Looking to continue your career in an environment that values your contribution and invests in your growth? We've curated a benefits package that helps to ensure that you don’t just work, but thrive at Globe Life:

• Competitive compensation designed to reflect your expertise and contribution.

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans because your well-being is fundamental to your performance.

• Robust life insurance benefits and retirement plans, including company-matched 401k and pension plan.

• Paid holidays and time off to support a healthy work-life balance.

• Parental leave to help our employees welcome their new additions.

• Subsidized all-in-one subscriptions to support your fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep goals.

• Company-paid counseling for assistance with mental health, stress management, and work-life balance.

• Continued education reimbursement eligibility and company-paid FLMI and ICA courses to grow your career.

• Discounted Texas Rangers tickets for a proud visit to Globe Life Field.

Opportunity awaits! Invest in your professional legacy, realize your path, and see the direct impact you can make in a workplace that celebrates and harnesses your unique talents and perspectives to their fullest potential. At Globe Life, your voice matters.
